newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge despite OMO.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge despite OMO.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates plunged at the close on reports that the central bank had picked up only a small amount in a special open market operation (OMO) on Thursday, dealers said.
Overnight funds were initially traded at 13.50 to 14 percent but rates slipped on an inflow of 2.8 billion rupees from maturity of an earlier OMO, one dealer said.
Rates crashed to two percent on news the the State (central) Bank of Pakistan had accepted only a small amount in the OMO.
Dealers said the market would open liquid on Saturday after the Friday weekend. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
